karatGuarantee.summary: One-year seller karat guarantee with original-buyer, sale-record and alteration conditions. It includes seller testing and is not a substitute for an independent jeweler.
karatGuarantee.quote: If anything you bought from TraxNYC tests under the gold karat or the sterling silver standard it was sold as, within one year of delivery, you choose: a replacement that tests as sold, or a full refund of the purchase price. No restocking fee or return shipping charge applies. This guarantee is separate from the 14-day return window above and from the 7-day defect window in our Terms of Service.
karatGuarantee.conditionsQuote: What it covers: the piece as we sold it, claimed by the original buyer and matching our record of the sale (item number and the gram weight on your appraisal). It doesn’t cover pieces resized, repaired, plated or otherwise altered by anyone other than TraxNYC, or parts that aren’t the main metal, such as clasp springs, solder joints, plating or stones.
